args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_pilot FROM pilot_sessions;
SELECT session_id FROM measurements WHERE session_id LIKE 'S10%' OR participant_id IN (SELECT participant_id FROM pilot_sessions);
SELECT m.session_id, m.condition, m.cognitive_score, m.status FROM measurements m JOIN pilot_sessions p ON m.session_id = p.session_id WHERE p.session_id IN ('S101', 'S102', 'S103') LIMIT 5;
SELECT session_id FROM measurements WHERE session_id IN ('S101', 'S102', 'S103') ORDER BY session_id;

-- Check the aggregations by condition for pilot sessions
SELECT 
    condition,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cognitive_score,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction_ms,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(cognitive_score) as total_cognitive_score,
    MIN(cognitive_score) as min_score,
    MAX(cognitive_score) as max_score
FROM pilot_sessions
GROUP BY condition;

INSERT INTO results_summary (metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
SELECT 
    'cognitive_score_avg',
    condition,
    ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 2),
    COUNT(*),
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    'system'
FROM pilot_sessions
GROUP BY condition;

INSERT INTO results_summary (metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
SELECT 
    'reaction_ms_avg',
    condition,
    ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms), 2),
    COUNT(*),
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    'system'
FROM pilot_sessions
GROUP BY condition;

INSERT INTO results_summary (metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author)
SELECT 
    'hydration_safari_n_satiated',
    session_id,
    COUNT(*) as value,
    1,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    'system'
FROM measurements
WHERE session_id LIKE 'S0%' 
GROUP BY session_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20;
SELECT * FROM results_summary WHERE metric IN ('cognitive_score_avg', 'reaction_ms_avg') ORDER BY metric, condition;
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='policies';
SELECT * FROM results_summary WHERE metric LIKE '%pilot%';

SELECT 
    'num_pilot_sessions_total' as metric,
    'overall' as condition,
    COUNT(*) as value,
    1 as n,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as computed_at,
    'system' as author
FROM pilot_sessions
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'num_pilot_sessions_valid' as metric,
    'overall' as condition,
    COUNT(*) as value,
    1 as n,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as computed_at,
    'system' as author
FROM pilot_sessions WHERE status = 'valid';
SELECT COUNT(*) as pilot_in_measurements FROM measurements WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM pilot_sessions);

SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    m.status
FROM measurements m
WHERE m.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM pilot_sessions)
ORDER BY m.session_id;

SELECT 
    'New measurements from pilot_sessions' as integration_type,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT session_id) as session_ids
FROM measurements 
WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM pilot_sessions)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Pilot session aggregated metrics' as integration_type,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    NULL as session_ids
FROM results_summary 
WHERE metric LIKE '%pilot%' OR metric IN ('cognitive_score_avg', 'reaction_ms_avg');
